v0.1.6a.notes:
AgentRT v0.1.6a (patch)

Fixes a system-level defect in the 0.1.6 binary install: running
`airymaxrt` with no arguments launched the frontend directly without
starting the daemon fleet, so every component reported offline
("online 0/17") and no feature was usable.

Changes:

- scripts/install: binary-mode launcher now brings up the daemon fleet
  on default (no-args) launch — reuse cached full launcher, otherwise
  bootstrap start (idempotent, offline-capable) before entering the
  frontend.
- launcher (latest/airymaxrt): after `airymaxrt update`, regenerate the
  entry launcher so existing 0.1.6 installs get the same no-args fix.
- Version SSoT sync to 0.1.6a (VERSION, installers, CLI/gateway/commons
  fallbacks, root CMakeLists now injects project() from the VERSION
  file).

Existing users: run `airymaxrt update` to upgrade from 0.1.6.
New users: one-line install automatically gets the fixed launcher.
